outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
The bar graph of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows individual dots (n=4 per group) overlaid on the bars representing the mean ± SD.
Tumor volume quantification is shown as a scatter/dot plot with each mouse plotted individually, along with mean and 95% CI error bars.
The bar graph of Tmprss11b mRNA expression (shRNA) shows individual data points (n=4 per group) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
This time-course plot shows only group means with SEM error bars at each timepoint; no individual mouse tumor volume data points or trajectories are displayed.
The CD4 intensity quantification bar graph has individual field measurements plotted as dots on top of the mean ± SD bars.
The pERK intensity quantification bar graph displays individual field measurements as dots overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
